scenes.headline: How a decision model's confidence becomes a threshold
scenes.sub: Liquid's d1-ultra, checked against the index's own calibration bins.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Kelvin! Liquid's new decision model says that when it is ninety percent sure, it is right. Let's see what that number is, and where it holds.

scenes.text: A decision model scores every option in one pass and returns probabilities. If those probabilities are calibrated, a threshold decides what runs without review.
scenes.say: A decision model scores every option and returns probabilities. If they are calibrated, a threshold can decide what runs without a person.

scenes.title: From a request to a routed decision

steps.say: The state and a question go in. Each question is its own prompt, and it is billed as one.
One scoring pass reads a score for every option. A softmax turns them into probabilities. Nothing is generated.
Take the probability of the chosen option and compare it with a threshold.
Above it, the decision runs on its own. Below it, a person looks.

scenes.title: Expected calibration error
scenes.text: ECE = sum over bins of n/N x |acc - conf|

parts.note: the gap inside one confidence bin
parts.say: Sort answers into bins by confidence. In each bin, compare how often it was right with how sure it said it was.

parts.note: weighted by how many answers land there
parts.say: Weight each gap by the share of answers in that bin, and add them up.

left.title: Pooled across benchmarks
items: They cancel before the absolute value
left.say: Pool four benchmarks into one curve, and errors that point in opposite directions cancel.

right.title: One task at a time
items: Underconfident on tool calls and safety
Confidently wrong on the hardest exam
right.say: Split them, and d1-ultra is cautious on tool calls and safety, and sure of itself on exam questions it gets wrong.

scenes.title: Pooled calibration error, Artificial Analysis bins
scenes.note: Per benchmark, d1-ultra ranks fourth of 13.
scenes.say: On the pooled curve, d1-ultra's error is three point six, a third of the next model's. Per benchmark, it ranks fourth.

scenes.label: Decision Index score, first of 13 decision models
scenes.note: Most of the lead is answering I don't know.
scenes.say: Its index score recomputes to sixty five point two five. Most of the lead comes from saying I don't know when it does not.

scenes.text: A threshold is only as good as the calibration on your own task. Measure it per task, never pooled.
scenes.say: A threshold is only as good as the calibration on your own task. Measure it per task, never pooled.

recap: Decision models score options, nothing generated
Calibration lets a threshold route work
scenes.say: Score the options, trust a threshold only where it is calibrated, and never pool.
